app.desc: Run the Flutter app on macOS with procm room logging (phone/emulator targets need the host LAN IP instead of 127.0.0.1)

app-windows.desc: Run the Flutter app on Windows with procm room logging

app-web.desc: Run the Flutter web app at http://127.0.0.1:8080

check-translations.desc: i18n quality gate: all '.tr' keys must be defined and zh/en dictionaries symmetric

server.desc: Dart storage server on port 8874: storage/auth/plugin REST API + MCP + WS, based on aboutme_data_sdk (drop-in replacement of nodejs server, same DATA_DIR layout)

server-build.desc: Compile the Dart storage server into a standalone executable (bin/aboutme-server)

server-admin-build.desc: Build the Vue admin UI into packages/aboutme_server/admin (served at /admin/ by the Dart server, hot pick-up on next request)

server-admin-dev.desc: Vite dev server for the Vue admin UI (port 3000, proxies /api to the Dart server on 8874)
